title: All O`one Data Structure
summary: Maintain string counts with inc/dec and return any minimum/maximum key; empty queries return an empty string. Every operation requires average constant time.
officialConstraints: Keys use 1–10 lowercase letters; decrement targets exist; at most 50000 operations.
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts at most 200 operations. Snapshot creation is linear in current key count, separate from data-structure operation cost.
